newsitem.title: USA: Health Professionals sets warrant value.
newsitem.headline: Health Professionals sets warrant value.

text.p: Health Professionals Inc said on Monday its board has voted to exempt the exercise price of outstanding class B warrants from adjustment for the one-for-ten reverse stock split which was approved by its shareholders.

Each of the 28,628 outstanding class B warrants, which will expire on December 9, 1997, entitles the holder to purchase two shares of the company's common stock for $10.34 ($5.17 per share), the company said.
The warrants are callable if the average closing price of the company's common stock equals or exceeds $7.50 for 20 consecutive days prior to the five days before calling, the company said.
